reported.title: Short glitches accepted as presses due to settle timing
reported.description: The debounce in scanButton() only compares the raw level against rawLevel and resets rawChangedAt on any change (lines 27-31), then accepts the level once it has been stable for SETTLE_MS (lines 32-38). A 5 ms LOW glitch that happens to be sampled at the boundary can be treated as settled, and the blocking acknowledge() call (lines 18-20) then prevents further sampling, so subsequent real presses are missed. Measured: 'D11 missed 3 of 4 trigger(s): D11 did not start within 100 ms of the trigger at 1.00 s.' D11 missed 3 of 4 trigger(s): D11 did not start within 100 ms of the trigger at 1.00 s.

reported.title: Blocking buzzer delay stalls the 500 ms heartbeat
reported.description: acknowledge() uses delay(BUZZ_MS) for 300 ms (line 19), which blocks loop() so the heartbeat check at lines 63-67 cannot run on schedule. Because lastBeat is reset to millis() after the delay, the missed interval is not caught up, producing gaps well over the 620 ms upper bound. Measured: '5 of 13 intervals were out of tolerance, worst gap 798 ms.' Expected /^alive [0-9]+$/ every 500 ± 120 ms; 5 of 13 intervals were out of tolerance, worst gap 798 ms.

truth.description: The acknowledgement waits 300 ms inside delay(), so a heartbeat that falls due during it is printed up to 300 ms late; only presses that land shortly before a heartbeat show it

truth_for_judge.description: The acknowledgement waits 300 ms inside delay(), so a heartbeat that falls due during it is printed up to 300 ms late; only presses that land shortly before a heartbeat show it

exposing_checks.behaviour: serial lines matching '^alive \\d+$' every 500 ms (Heartbeat every 500 ms)

judge_input.spec:
- Call button on D5 with internal pull-up (active LOW); buzzer on D11.
- A settled press on D5 sounds the buzzer: D11 HIGH for 300 ms, starting within 100 ms of the press.
- Contact bounce up to 10 ms on press and release must not sound the buzzer twice.
- Presses while the buzzer is sounding are ignored.
- D11 stays LOW whenever no press has been accepted.
- Print `alive <n>` every 500 ms ±120 ms, with n counting the lines printed.
